# B2Brouter French flow test fixtures

[intragile.eu](https://intragile.eu)

Hand-written JSON bodies that follow the shapes of the B2Brouter API `2026-06-26` French directory answers: the `ExternalCompany` object, flat as the API returns it and wrapped in `external_company` as the French guide shows it, the `processing` answer and the general `error` object. Names and identifiers are fictitious; the two short status messages are re-typed from sandbox answers, no documentation text is copied, and no `request_log_url` points at a real request.
